body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics introduced ‘32LC32DQ’, a 32-inch ''ez U'' LCD TV during KES 2006. It features easy-to-use OSD, remote control, and a hot key to adjust brightness.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
